entry.summaryHtml: Cocoa, sweet tobacco, fruit, nuts and pepper give JOYA Black a dark but rounded small-format profile. Mexican San Andrés over an all-Nicaraguan core keeps the smoke richer and sweeter than its medium body suggests, with the early pepper settling into cocoa, fruit and a nutty finish. The 4″ × 32 format should favour concentration without the nicotine aggression of Antaño 1970.
